name: Eloise Taulner
source:
Greeting everyone with a warm smile, Eloise makes sure to show up for her practice on time every day with the goal of improving. But don't be deceived by the Ultimate Fencer's size, as she is extremely agile with a sabre. While advancing towards her opponents is common practice in fencing, she prefers to lay low and blend in with the crowd during social encounters, and is always ready to make her escape if anyone gets too close to her.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1350500984615743488]official description[/url]]
